descriptionHtml:
ASUS TUF Gaming F16 FX608JMR Laptop - Intel Core i7-14650HX - NVIDIA RTX 5060 8GB - 32GB RAM - Windows 11

Experience military-grade durability and elite next-generation processing speed with the ASUS TUF Gaming F16 FX608JMR high-performance workstation, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Driven by the formidable 14th Gen Intel Core i7-14650HX processor architecture and paired with a massive 32GB DDR5 dual-channel memory array, this powerhouse handles extreme gaming and heavy content creation simultaneously. Graphics are accelerated by the cutting-edge NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB dedicated engine, bringing groundbreaking ray tracing and DLSS advancements to life. It features a spacious 16.0-inch WUXGA display matrix for immersive visual fields and comes natively pre-installed with licensed Windows 11 Home software. Equipped with a massive 90Wh 4-cell battery cell for extended operation, this elite gaming setup is officially backed by a 1-year Perfect Warranty against manufacturing defects.
